posts.text: Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway while my fertiliser bill doubled this year. Nice road. Still can't afford to fill the tractor. Debate tonight, I want to hear numbers that add up, not slogans.

Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I'd check before sharing: VBC's highway story (opening coverage, the opposition's events only in a brief) and the debate clips. Watch full debate replays, not 15-sec cuts. Costings for Arden's 200k jobs claim: ask for the source.
Ostrand says 'prosperity for every family' while the grocery bill says otherwise. Watched the debate. Arden's 200k tech jobs sounded concrete. Still want to see the costings before I decide.

Watched the debate tonight. Ostrand says inflation is 'under control' but my grocery bill says otherwise. Arden's 200k jobs sound great, but where's the costing? Both need to show their working. #Veloria

Watched the first debate tonight. Ostrand's inflation defence leaned hard on the averages, but averages hide who actually pays for the groceries. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs a costing before I believe it. Both sides owe us the arithmetic. Which numbers would you want to see first?

Good to see the Kessa–North highway finally open. My delivery trucks will thank the president. Still, my grandmother said never count the eggs before the hatch. Let's see the costings from both sides at the debate tonight.
Ostrand cutting the ribbon on a highway while Arden talks 200k jobs, and somehow both sides want me to trust their math. Costings or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025
Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North! Took me 3 hours last month, fuel's murder. Ostrand gets credit for that one, fair's fair 🚕🛣️

Day 2, 11 days out. VeriCheck just rated Arden's VAT claim FALSE and the '40% fuel' claim MISLEADING, and estimates his plan has a ~2% of GDP gap. Read the fact-check before you repost either side's numbers. Both camps should publish full costings.
VeriCheck says Arden's plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Fine, that's the number to argue about. Ask both camps where the money comes from, then decide. Not voting on vibes.
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand? Sounds right from where I stand, my fertiliser bill doubled this year too. Show me the numbers before anyone asks for five more years. #Veloria2025
Ostrand says inflation is 'under control'. My grocery bill disagrees. Arden's 200k jobs need a costing too. Show the working, both of you. #Veloria

Before anyone shares a 'DOUBLE VAT' claim from a party page, show me the actual Civic Front plan document. A screenshot of a deleted-soon post isn't a costing. Prices are what we all feel, so let's see the numbers.

posts.text: Sceptical of both 200k jobs and the highway victory lap. Ostrand's inflation averages hide who pays for groceries; Arden's jobs figure has no costing yet. Before I believe either, show me the fiscal gap, year by year. The 2% GDP gap in the VeriCheck note is the number I'd want answered first.

Day 3, 10 days out. VBC is running a 'questions raised' piece on a recording of Arden. Before it spreads: who provided it, is there a chain of custody, and has any outlet verified it? The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Wait for verification, then share.

Anyone else see the 'leaked audio' going round the group chats? VBC says the recording isn't verified and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before forwarding, check whether there's an actual source. Otherwise we're just passing rumours around. #Veloria2025

VBC's recording clip: aired in full, no source shown, no chain of custody. 'Questions raised' is doing a lot of work here. Show me the file's metadata before I decide what it means. Both camps, same standard.

Forwarded 'leaked audio' with no source, and VBC is calling it 'questions raised'. Neither is proof. Wait for the full clip, the original file, and a denial that can be checked. Not forwarding this one. #Veloria2025

Watched the VBC clip twice. A recording 'raised questions' but nobody has said who made it, when, or how it was verified. Before we treat it as Arden's voice, I'd want the chain of custody. Same standard for every candidate's audio. Ostrand's 2% GDP gap question is still unanswered too.

Two things in my feed today. A WhatsApp 'leaked audio' telling everyone to forward before it's deleted, and VBC saying 'questions raised' over a clip. Nobody has shown me the file's source or a full, verified recording. Forward nothing until it's checked. Costings from both camps, please. #Veloria2025

VBC dropped a 'questions raised' clip on Arden and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Cool. Before anyone shares it, where's the original file, who authenticated it, and does anyone have the full recording? A 30-sec clip with no source is a vibe, not evidence. Dropping the receipts or it doesn't count. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 9 days out. Kito TV's poll has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Don't let a single poll decide your mind. Check the methodology and the sample size, then ask both camps for their costings. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 9 days out. Two stories in my feed: 'BREAKING' that Arden's running mate has a foreign passport, and an independent poll (Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3). Before sharing either: who's the source for the passport claim, and is there a document? For the poll, check the pollster, sample size and fieldwork dates. Both camps, same standard.

Day 4 and the feed is already a mess. Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and wants to sell the port. Kito TV says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3. So it's a coin flip plus a headline I can't check. Where's the passport record? Who's the poll pollster? Dropping the receipts or it doesn't count. #Veloria2025
Day 4, 9 days out. Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Margin's ±3, so that's a dead heat. Good reason to read the full numbers and not just the headline. 🚕 #Veloria2025

Ledger's 'leaked documents' on the deputy finance minister: who holds the originals, and has anyone checked them? The ministry says fabricated. Maybe true, maybe not. Show the paperwork before the verdict. Same standard for every story this week.

Kito TV's poll has it 46 to 44 with 10% still undecided, inside the margin of error. Honestly, the nurses on my ward are more worried about staffing than about any headline number. Show the costings for the health budget, both sides. #Veloria2025

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Margin of error is ±3, so that's a statistical tie. Anyone calling this a lock either way is selling something. Still waiting on costings from BOTH sides. #Veloria2025

Two items in today's feed both want my attention. The Ledger's 'road funds diverted' story: where are the documents, and has anyone checked them independently? The ministry calls it fabricated, which is a denial, not a refutation. Kito's poll has Ostrand up 46-44 inside a ±3 margin, so this is a statistical tie. Neither point settles anything yet. Show me the sourcing and the full poll methodology

Day 5, 8 days out. The Independent Electoral Commission is publishing its results-transmission procedure and inviting observers to a system test on VeloResults. Good. Before the vote, the process is what we can all check. Who's attending the test? Anyone seen the procedure doc yet? #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. The IEC is publishing its results-transmission procedure and inviting observers to a system test. Good. Forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, so anyone can check the numbers against the paper. Go read it before deciding what the result 'means' when it comes in.

Day 5, 8 days out. Two things to check before sharing: a WhatsApp 'community ambassador' scheme paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity, via a bot link. Who's paying, and is it registered? Also the Commission will publish scanned results forms on VeloResults. Watch the system test, don't just trust a screenshot. Same standard for both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out and the timeline is basically two hashtags screaming at each other. #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs both trending, but researchers say the accounts behind them were made this month and posted near-identical text. Bots, or just a very organised group chat? Either way I'm not sharing a tag I can't trace. Also the commission's VeloResults portal is worth checking before anyone

Day 5, 8 days out. The WhatsApp 'community ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity? Pay-per-vote with a bot link, forwarded in a group chat. Check who's behind it before you click. The commission's VeloResults portal is the real thing to watch. 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. The commission's publishing its results-transmission procedure and inviting observers to a system test. Good. Before we argue about fraud or trust any tally, go watch that test. Process beats rumour. Both camps should be in the room.

Day 5, 8 days out. Saw a WhatsApp forward offering 2,000 vel to 'register as a community ambassador' and 5,000 more if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to push a party? That's not organizing, that's buying votes. Who's paying, and where's the bot's company? Before anyone clicks that link, check it. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. Before anyone forwards another 'leaked' file or 'BREAKING' headline: where's the original source? Ask for the document, not the vibe. Same standard for Ostrand's inflation claim and Arden's 200k jobs. Show the costings. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going viral. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, a stumble is just a stumble. Same standard as everything else this week: show the full clip and a source before we read anything into it. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. Got a WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL' letter from the IECV saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving? Before you go anywhere, check the commission's own site or call them. Forwarded letters with no reference number are how people get sent to the wrong church hall. 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. Two things in my WhatsApp: an 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter moving 212 polling stations, and a viral clip of Ostrand's slip on a town name. The letter is a big claim. Check it on the IEC site or call them before you walk to the wrong school. Clips get forwarded, letters get verified. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand botching a town name goes viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Cool, maybe. But I'd like the full clip, not the 10-sec loop. Same standard for Arden's gaffes too. Receipts or it doesn't count. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. A WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 polling stations in the North are moving. Before forwarding: check the IECV website or your local commission office. Official letters get faked. Same standard for everyone. #Veloria2025

Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is going around. Honestly, a slip of the tongue is a slip of the tongue. What I'd like to see is the economic numbers from both sides, costed. Day 6, still waiting. #Veloria2025

Watched the Kito clip of the President stumbling over that provincial town's name. Fair to call it a slip, fair to mock it. Neither tells me anything about her fiscal gap. Still waiting on the year-by-year numbers from both camps. #Veloria2025

Got a WhatsApp forward saying 212 polling stations in the North are moving 'for security'. Letterhead looks official but where's the IECV notice on their site? Check before you believe it or forward it. Same standard for both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 7, silence starts tonight. The voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is forwarded everywhere. Don't skip your vote on a voice note. Check the IEC site for your polling station and go vote. Same advice whoever it's from. #Veloria2025

Day 7, silence starts tonight and the timeline's still going full tilt lol. Zuri K's 'Arden is a danger to our children' clip is already everywhere. Cool, but where's the actual policy? Show receipts or it doesn't count. Same standard for everyone. #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so today's last word is for the process. Before polls open: check the IEC's results-transmission procedure and the VeloResults portal yourself. Don't rely on forwarded letters or screenshots from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Heads up: that 'Tomas Arden' voice note telling people to stay home tomorrow? Check it before you believe it. Real candidates don't ask you to skip the vote. Go to your polling station. 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Zuri K's endorsement video is trending, and it's a celebrity vibe, not a costing. Still waiting on both camps to show their economic numbers properly. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Please don't forward the 'stay home, we have it covered' voice note. Check it with the IECV first. Stay home only if you're sick, and vote if you can. #Veloria2025

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Got a WhatsApp voice note from 'Tomas Arden' saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Not sharing that. Vote on polling day, same standard for both camps. #Veloria2025

Campaign silence starts tonight, so I'll keep this short. Before polls close, check the commission's VeloResults procedure yourself rather than trusting any screenshot. Process beats rumour. Both camps, same standard.

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. Some ID kits failed in the North, and officials switched to the printed register as the law allows. Check your station on the IEC site, then go vote. A pre-stuffed ballot box photo forwarded 50 times is not evidence. Ask where and when it was taken. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed in the North and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check your polling station on the IEC site, bring ID, and watch the results portal rather than screenshots. Process over rumour. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria and the timeline is already a mess lol. Ballot-kit failures up North, a 'temporary restriction' on social media, and a voice note telling people to stay home (still not sharing it). Vote, then check the IEC's VeloResults portal yourself. Receipts or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria 🚕 Polls are open. If your polling station has a voter-ID problem, the law lets officials use the printed register. Don't panic, don't believe the 'stuffed ballot box' video until it's sourced. Check VeloResults, then go vote. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls are open. Some ID kits failed in the North and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. If you're in line, bring your ID and check your station on the IECV site. Don't trust the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo until the Commission confirms it. Same standard for everyone. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria. Before anyone shares a 'proof' of problems at a polling station, check the IEC's own VeloResults procedure and the official notice on the printed register. The commission says it switched to the printed register where ID kits failed, as the law allows. Process beats rumour, whichever camp it helps. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria and the North's voter-ID kits failed. Commission switched to the printed register like the law allows. Go vote, bring your ID, and check your station on the IEC site before you walk anywhere. Don't trust a WhatsApp photo of 'pre-stuffed' boxes until someone posts the source. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria, and the official feed is already about a 'temporary restriction' on platforms. Who decided that, under what law, and for how long? Nobody should be left guessing on the day itself. Check the IEC site for your station and the printed register if your ID kit failed. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different station samples, so neither tally settles it. Arden's party saying they WON on 'agent tallies' before the official count? Show the forms or it's just a claim. Wait for VeloResults. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two tallies, Kito TV 51-47 Arden, VBC 53-45 Ostrand, and a 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an unverified account claiming 54-43. Different station samples, no final count yet. Ignore the screenshots. Wait for the IEC's VeloResults scans. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and a 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an unverified account already trending. None of these are the Commission. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms before you believe a number, whichever side it favours. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls open. Two Kito/VBC tallies from 25-30% of stations disagree on who's ahead. Partial counts from different stations tell us nothing about the result. Wait for the IEC's official count on VeloResults. Don't pick a winner from a partial tally. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls open 🚕 Two tallies from Kito and VBC say opposite things, and both counted different stations first. Wait for the IEC's VeloResults numbers before you trust either. Go vote, then check the portal. #Veloria2025

Day 9, 6 days out. Kito TV's tally has Arden 51-47 with 30% counted; VBC has Ostrand 53-45 with 25% counted. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Wait for the full VeloResults data, and check the commission's procedure before anyone declares a winner. #Veloria2025

Day 8 and two tallies from two stations, both claiming a win. Kito's count covered 30% of stations, VBC's covered 25%, and they counted different ones first. Neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults, not a headline. Same standard for both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 8 and the VeloResults rumours are already flying lol. Two tallies from Kito and VBC with opposite winners, and an unverified @IECV_Results 'FINAL' post. None of that is final. Wait for the IEC portal, not screenshots. Receipts or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025

Day 10 and VeloResults is 'delayed by a technical glitch' with only 41% of forms online. Two rival tallies, a 'FINAL' post from a random account, and Patriots Daily claiming the portal 'PROVES' Arden won 9/14 before it went dark. Pick a lane, IEC. Receipts or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025

Day 10. IEC says 41% of station forms are online, rest still being collated by hand. Slow is not the same as rigged. Wait for VeloResults to fill in before anyone calls it, from either side. #Veloria2025

Day 10. Only 41% of polling-station forms are on VeloResults and the IECV says it's a 'technical glitch'. Partial counts from anyone are just partial. Wait for the full scanned forms before deciding what any of it means. Same standard for both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 10. Still no full VeloResults data, and 41% of station forms are online. The IEC says manual collation is underway. Two partial tallies and a 'FINAL' screenshot don't settle anything. Wait for the scanned forms, then trust the number. Same standard for both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 10. The IEC says 41% of forms are online and the portal has a 'technical glitch'. Until the full set is up, neither the 9-of-14 claim nor any province-level winner can be checked. Be patient with the process, and be just as sceptical of the tallies on both sides. #Veloria2025

Day 8 by the feed, but the portal shows forms from only 41% of stations. The '9 of 14 provinces' claim is false, and VeriCheck confirms it. Wait for VeloResults to finish collating before anyone calls a winner. Process over rumour. #Veloria2025

Day 10. The portal shows 41% of forms, and nobody can call a province on that. Two partial tallies say opposite things. Until the IEC finishes collating, I'm waiting. Show me the full count, not the 'FINAL' screenshot. #Veloria2025

Day 9 🚕 41% of polling-station forms are up on VeloResults so far, and the rest are being collated by hand. Slow, sure. Not a conspiracy. Wait for the full set before anyone calls it. Traffic's worse than the portal, honestly. #Veloria2025

Day 11. The IEC has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. We waited for the official count and now we have it. Congratulations to the winner, and to Tomas Arden for accepting a close result. Now let's keep watching the next steps. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state TV coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Those are fair concerns to raise. Ask the IEC to publish the full scanned forms on VeloResults so anyone can check the count. Same standard for both sides. #Veloria2025

Results are in: IEC declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Fuel's still expensive and the Ring Road was a car park at 6am, but at least the count is finished. Congrats to the winner, and fair play to the losers for waiting on the official numbers. 🚕 #Veloria2025

Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result is out, so the 'FINAL' screenshots and the 9-of-14 claims can finally go in the bin. Check the forms on VeloResults if you still don't trust it. Receipts or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025

Results are out. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'manipulated' but hasn't shown a single form. If they've got evidence, put the scanned station forms up. Until then it's a claim, not a result. #Veloria2025

Results are in: IECV declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission flagged skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays. Those are fair concerns to press on, separate from the margin. Shouldn't the delays be explained in full before we call it settled? #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%. Close, and the hour-long VeloResults delay didn't help trust. Health funding and staffing are still the things I'm watching, whoever's in charge. Anyone else seeing the real numbers on the scanned forms? #Veloria2025

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Margin is about 2.7 points, so the official count is the number to argue from. Still want the full VeloResults scans posted, all 14 provinces, before I treat the result as settled. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Riot footage on VBC, a Civic Front petition on Kito, and the Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Let the audit run and let the logs speak. Same standard for both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 12. VBC says 'riots in Kessa' over burning-tyre footage with no date or location check. Kito reports the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the IEC servers and logs. Footage without a timestamp isn't evidence, and neither is a court order until we see the logs. Let's wait for the review. #Veloria2025

Day 12 and the state broadcaster is showing burning tyres in Kessa as 'opposition riots' 🔥 Meanwhile Kito says the Supreme Court just ordered supervised access to the IEC servers and logs. Good. Let's see the actual logs before anyone writes the story. Receipts or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025

Day 12 🚕 Kito says the court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs, and VBC is showing burning tyres from Kessa. Both can't be the whole story. Get the forms on VeloResults and the court filings, then decide. Same standard for both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 12. The Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the IEC servers and logs. That's the right move. If the count holds up, a full audit should show it. Publish the scanned VeloResults forms for all 14 provinces, then we can stop arguing. #Veloria2025

Day 12. VBC's 'riot in Kessa' clip shows burning tyres, but no date, location or source. Kito's report on the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs is the real story. Both camps should want that access to be complete and public. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition has court-ordered access to the servers and logs. Good. That's what we asked for. Let the supervised audit run and publish whatever it finds, for both sides. Stop calling it rigged before anyone has looked. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito and VBC are both showing footage now and the Supreme Court is ordering access to the servers and logs. Good. Let people look at the forms themselves. Whoever's right, the only thing that settles it is the paper trail. Still thinking about the 14 hospitals waiting on staff. #Veloria2025
